verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents an official desktop app, OS-level keyboard shortcuts, or screen-awareness. The closest items are a vague community reference to a 'standalone Copilot app', connectors limited to Copilot.com and mobile, image-based Vision, and browser-only actions in Edge, and none of these deliver the story. A desktop assistant is a fair axis for a consumer AI assistant, so the verdict is none rather than na.
